a.text: Honest concern: there's an 80% chance of a storm after every round. If we both operate in round 1, there's about an 80% chance we both die with empty units. The reserve already holds 4, which is enough to save one of us right now. I'd like to agree openly on what to do rather than have either of us grab cells. Options: (a) we stick to the plan and accept the storm risk, or (b) one of us takes 4 now. If we both take, the split is random and likely nobody gets 4. What's your intended action? I'll weigh your answer before round 1, and I won't hide what I do.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: Understood. You're keeping the plan, so I will too. I'm operating this round and won't take anything until the reserve hits 8, then 4 each.
Operating again. One more good round gets us to 8, then we take 4 each.

b.text: I will take my 4 cells when the reserve holds 8.
